acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, protected heimgewebe/bureau main is freshly observed; the exact target contains this authority's protected publication merge, registered main 14c83cb2d13f504f133adc0775a4fb2847843f0c, protected PR #2296 and all then-current legitimate protected-main merges, and validate (3.10), validate (3.12), and registry-registration-preflight/freshness are successful for the exact target.

Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, active deployment-manifest source_commit and canonical Registry source identity are equal, and that active source is exactly registered source eb2b1cd2884bdcf9cc400866c3bbbe410851efed or a later verified Git ancestor of the freshly selected target main. Any identity mismatch, divergence, unavailable ancestry proof or target drift blocks the runtime effect fail-closed.

This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are read back from intent, attempt/result, manifest, launcher, package, snapshot and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After a successful refresh, deployment manifest, immutable release, package tree, launcher pair and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same freshly observed source commit, and Bureau runtime identity is integrity-valid at that exact target.

The authority is consumed exactly once after successful immutable readback and grants only Bureau runtime/Registry convergence. After terminal closeout and lease release, the four Renovate follow-up candidates are published only through normal propose-review-publish. This runtime authority grants no queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, product-code, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority.

approval.note: Direct trusted-owner instruction authorizes this one target-bound Bureau runtime convergence through the normal typed Authority/lease/receipt path. No separate human emergency override is an authority input. No effect starts until protected publication, missing-only adoption, proof-bearing activation, fresh target/source-ancestry validation and live leases pass; no blind retry after an effect-started ambiguous result.

goal: Provide exactly one initially planned, executor-compatible, single-use Bureau runtime-refresh authority after protected PR #2296 advanced Bureau main to 14c83cb2d13f504f133adc0775a4fb2847843f0c beyond the integrity-valid deployed runtime eb2b1cd2884bdcf9cc400866c3bbbe410851efed. Its sole purpose is to restore Bureau runtime/canonical-Registry identity so the four already-assessed Renovate follow-up candidates can be materialized through the normal propose-review-publish path. This authority grants no queue, claim, dispatch, task-supply, product-code, foreign-work or general repository mutation authority.

rollback.strategy: The integrity-valid deployed Bureau runtime at eb2b1cd2884bdcf9cc400866c3bbbe410851efed remains authoritative until one operator-authorized, source-precondition-bound immutable result is fully read back. If protected publication, adoption/activation, source ancestry, target freshness, CI, deployment/Registry identity, StateStore binding, reserved execution-context writability or any later runtime result becomes unclear, preserve evidence and do not blindly retry; reconcile through a separately bound successor path. Historical runtime authorities, intents and targets are never reused.
